items.headline: Former MLB star Mark Teixeira wins U.S. House seat in Texas
items.description: Republican Mark Teixeira, a three-time Major League Baseball All-Star, has won election to the U.S. House in Texas' 21st Congressional District. Also Tuesday, former college football coach Tommy Tuberville won the Alabama gubernatorial race.

items.headline: College Football Playoff Bubble Watch after first ranking
items.description: A conference-by-conference look at which teams are contending for the playoff, who's close and who's out.

items.headline: Auburn's Alex Golesh discusses balancing gameplan, previews Arkansas
items.description: Golesh harps on the Tigers unraveling at the end of Auburn's loss to Ole Miss and explains how they want to get the running backs involved more ahead of their matchup against the Razorbacks.

items.headline: Auburn hosts Arkansas in SEC play
